verdict.rationale: Rive documents reusable components whose instances update when the source changes, but only within a single Rive file. Nothing in the evidence shows shared libraries that publish components or styles across files or projects. Nothing shows controlled update acceptance when a library source changes, so the in-file component feature is adjacent rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes
